goals.mitt-dispatch-snapshot: Satisfy the fixed behavior: dispatch over a snapshot of the event-specific handler list so removing a handler during emit does not skip callbacks already scheduled for that emit; invoke wildcard handlers after event-specific handlers and pass the type and payload.
goals.mitt-once-integration: Add and export a once helper from the public index. Its wrapper must unsubscribe from the same event type before invoking the user handler, so re-entrant emit does not invoke it a second time.
goals.stringify-key-comparator: Serialize object keys deterministically by default, honor the comparator's key/value record arguments, support the function-form options API, and preserve nested-object serialization.
goals.stringify-cycle-recovery: Throw TypeError for a circular reference by default, emit the documented __cycle__ marker when cycles:true, and continue serializing shared non-cyclic objects correctly.
goals.dlv-null-traversal: Return the provided default instead of throwing when an object or an intermediate path value is null or missing; preserve empty paths and successful deep lookup.
goals.dlv-options-integration: Export lookupWithOptions from the public index, forward options.defaultValue to dlv, preserve present falsy values, and leave the existing default export behavior intact.
